_status: FROZEN 2026-09-19 after Viraj's review. NEVER TRAINING DATA. A verdict change is a new version (HELDOUT-EVAL-v2.json), never an edit to this file; check_heldout.py refuses this file if its sha256 changes.
_rule: These cases are never used as training pairs, never as few-shot examples and never as demo presets. Pair generation is checked against them for overlap (check_heldout.py --leak). Changing a verdict is a clinical decision.
_mix: 4 red / 7 yellow / 11 green = 18/32/50%. 2/7/11 kept from review; two reds added on Viraj's call so the eval can catch the chunk-to-colour shortcut on CP-PERI and CP-PNA too. Worth the move from the 7/34/59 base rate.
_categories: As the model's system prompt defines them: red = emergency, needs immediate care, minutes matter; yellow = priority, needs assessment within hours; green = non-urgent, can wait or be self-managed.

cases.symptoms: For about forty minutes my upper back and left shoulder have been aching, I get out of breath just sitting here, and I suddenly feel completely drained and a bit queasy. There is no real chest pain.
